actualInspection.notes: Actually inspected35 final terrain images:seven cameras across source master and four browser levels. Public GUGiK WCS retains exact Float32 bare-earth2m crop and bounded0.5m surface crop;the native6m grid contains6660 values. CRS conversion uses EPSG2180 service advertised easting,northing with always_xy. ModelY0 is a working19m Highcourt floor in advertisedPL-EVRF2007-NH;runtime reference subtracts actual local grid bare earth -0.7849167m. Working relative floors include Middle-3.8m,entry-4.7m,Dansker-10.4m,Palace-9.4m and Lower ranges around-7..-10m. Foundations extend beneath local slopes and defensive walls follow local relief without a second castle hill or whole-precinct excavation. Narrow3-section entry/bridge caps follow mapped centerline and working grades;floor probes are within3cm and clear the terrain. Public surface crop informs approximate keep crown68.5m and pole77.5m absolute,not surveyed ground-relative heights. Three actual grid-vertex probes show.015m clearance. Four mapped occupied-wall ray sets test foundation contact;five unload cycles restore terrain and leave0model geometries. Source/medium terrain preview resamples the retained grid to4m and clamps outside its bounded extent for display only;no evidence outside the crop is asserted. National terrain reuse is publicly allowed with attribution;no inventedCCBYlicense or exact acquisition vintage/vertical accuracy is claimed. Host terrain must supply comparable local detail.
